acceptance_criteria: A release-only opt-in probe physically initializes, hashes, compresses and fully verifies 1,073,741,824 dense voxel bytes with bounded scratch space and memory guards. Deterministic reusable worlds address exact 1024-cubed space with explicit unique and repeated occupied-cell counts. Native and portable world copies round-trip. Metal camera submission and synchronized offscreen frame measurements record culling, proxies, memory and mesh reuse. Ordinary tests are small. Existing 256-cell editable model, format and rendering limits remain unchanged.
